title: Data Handling
description: Class 4 IMO — Data handling: tally charts and frequency tables, bar graphs with scales, an introduction to pie charts, and finding the mode (most frequent value).

topics.title: Tally Charts & Frequency Tables
topics.concept: Tally marks record counts in groups of five — four lines with a fifth crossing them. The frequency is how many times something happens. A frequency table lists each item next to its count.

examples.problem: How many does one full tally group stand for?
examples.solution: A full group (four lines crossed by a fifth) stands for 5.

examples.problem: A frequency table shows what for each item?
examples.solution: The number of times it occurs (its frequency).

recap: Tally marks group counts in fives.
Frequency = how many times something happens.

quiz.q: Two full tally groups stand for ___ ?
A frequency table shows the ___ of each item.
quiz.explanation: It shows the count (frequency) of each item.

topics.title: Bar Graphs with a Scale
topics.concept:
A bar graph shows data using bars whose heights give the values. The scale tells how much each unit stands for. If the scale is 5, a bar that reaches 4 units means 4 × 5 = 20.

The tallest bar shows the most and the shortest shows the least.

examples.problem: On a graph with scale 10, a bar reaches 3 units. What value is that?
What does the tallest bar show?

recap: The scale tells how much each unit stands for.
Tallest bar = most; shortest bar = least.

quiz.q: With a scale of 5, a bar that reaches 6 units stands for ___ ?
On a bar graph, the shortest bar shows the ___ ?
quiz.explanation: The shortest bar shows the least.

topics.title: Pie Charts & Mode
topics.concept:
A pie chart shows parts of a whole as slices of a circle. A slice that is half the circle means half the data chose that option.

The mode is the value that appears most often. In the data 3, 5, 3, 7, 3 the mode is 3 because it appears the most.

examples.solution: 3 appears most often, so the mode is 3.

examples.problem: A pie chart shows half the circle for football. What does that mean?
examples.solution: Half of the people chose football.

recap: A pie chart shows parts of a whole as slices.
Mode = the value that appears most often.

quiz.explanation: 4 appears three times, more than any other, so the mode is 4.

quiz.q: If a pie chart shows half the circle for cricket, that means ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Half the circle means half the people chose cricket.
